versions.content: The Ethernet Switch driver shall support an API which allows to store learned parameters like address resolution tables in a persistent manner by using the API EthSwt_StoreConfiguration . This persistent storage can be done in an NVRAM of the host CPU which runs the Ethernet Switch driver. Alternatively, this can be done in a memory of the switch itself. The trigger for storing the learned configuration or resetting the stored configuration can be done e.g. by a DCM.
